answer: An invitation is only renewed when the invited identity has produced work that a stranger attested, so waiting out a quarantine window is worthless and only per-identity attested work ages an account into the trusted tier. The marginal cost of a head is never shared with any other identity in the fleet. Picture a walnut verified individually, a lantern who has no stake in the farm, and a knoll earned by both: skipping the walnut means skipping the lantern, and without the lantern there is no knoll. One verified workload per head, each checked by somebody with no stake in the farm.
